summary: Acer Predator Helios Neo 16 (Exact Model: 16-GRXK-6G4H) - High-performance gaming laptop with Intel Core i7 processor and NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 graphics card experiencing constant game crashes.
detected_fault: Potential issue with the system's power management or cooling system, possibly related to the graphics card or NVIDIA drivers.
suggested_solution: Investigate further, gather more information about the system's behavior and logs, run diagnostic tests to identify any underlying problems, and consider updating NVIDIA drivers and reviewing power management settings.
